name: Tarun Kumar Nanda
title: Senior Software Engineer

points: Modernized legacy .NET transaction tracking system (Eserve) into Spring Boot microservices, improving scalability and reducing downtime.
Authored detailed documentation of legacy workflows, enabling smoother knowledge transfer and reducing onboarding time for new developers by 30%.
Achieved 100% unit test coverage and improved SonarQube compliance score to 95+, ensuring robust code quality and maintainability.
Containerized applications with Docker and automated deployment using Jules scripts on GKP (JPMC’s Kubernetes platform), cutting deployment effort by 40%.
Streamlined CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, reducing release cycle time from weeks to days across DEV and UAT environments.
Delivered secure, production‑ready REST APIs for frontend integration, enabling faster UI team adoption and reducing integration defects.
Enhanced collaboration and code quality through peer reviews and static analysis using BMAD, GitHub Copilot, and Claude.
Designed to store comprehensive school data, encompassing student and academic records, in a centralized database.
Ensured up to 90% unit test coverage by implementing rigorous testing with Junit and Mockito.
Diagnosed, analyzed, and resolved defects across UAT and production environments based on client requirements.
Engineered and optimized automated PDF and Excel report generation using Jaspersoft Studio.
Worked on OnePDL, a proprietary ETL tool that extracts, processes, validates, and transforms data as per the SPM tool.
Analyzed business and resource requirements to develop effective solutions.
Developed microservices for efficient data transformation using Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring MVC, Swagger API, and MySQL.
Hands-on experience with JUnit and Mockito, utilizing JaCoCo to ensure high code coverage.
Basic knowledge of Kafka with Spring Boot for real-time data streaming.
Familiar with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker.
Managed tasks efficiently using JIRA within an Agile framework to ensure timely project delivery.

headline: Java Full Stack Engineer
about: Full-Stack Java Developer with nearly 5 years of experience delivering enterprise-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Docker, and Kubernetes. Proven track record in microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and CI/CD automation for global clients.
Achieved 100% unit test coverage and a 95+ SonarQube score, cut deployment effort by 40%, and reduced release cycles from weeks to days. Strong expertise in Kafka, MySQL, and AWS.
Recipient of Accenture's ACE Award for outstanding performance. Passionate about solving complex challenges in fast-paced, collaborative environments.
Currently exploring Gen AI and agentic AI in the Java ecosystem to build intelligent, LLM-powered enterprise applications.
